shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files | head -50 && cat package.json

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i -C 3 "markdown-editor|markdown" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40; ls; cat .gitignore
npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor peerDependenciesMeta --json; ls __agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null | head

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components@^4 @diplodoc/transform@^4 katex@^0.16 markdown-it@^13 @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension 2>&1 | tail -15
for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json | tr -d '[]", ' | grep '^4\.' | tail -12); do echo "$v $(npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit)"; done

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 @diplodoc/transform@^4 katex@^0.16 markdown-it@^13 @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension 2>&1 | tail -15; grep -E '"(@gravity-ui|@diplodoc|katex|markdown-it)' package.json; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh markdown-editor useMarkdownEditor MarkdownEditorView 2>&1 | head -60
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh markdown-editor useMarkdownEditor MarkdownEditorView 2>&1 | head -60
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; ls build/docs build/docs/*
cat build/docs/guides/how-to-add-preview.md | head -120; rg -n -C 3 "initial|split|mode|md:|handlers" build/docs/guides/how-to-customize-the-editor.md | head -100
f=$(rg -l "export declare function useMarkdownEditor|useMarkdownEditor" build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -5); echo "$f"; rg -l "MarkdownEditorOptions\b" build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head;

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle && cat useMarkdownEditor.d.ts; cat types.d.ts | head -150; cat index.d.ts; rg -n "Props|export" MarkdownEditorView.d.ts | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor && sed -n 150,260p build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts; sed -n 1,20p build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts; rg -n "on\(|off\(|'change'|submit|getValue|clear|EventMap" build/esm/bundle/editor-public-types.js build/esm/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; rg -n "placeholder" build/esm/bundle/preset-base-types.d.ts; grep -n '"exports"' -A30 package.json | rg -n "styles|css|\"\./" | head -20

cat build/esm/bundle/events.d.ts; sed -n 1,40p build/esm/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts; sed -n 1,25p build/esm/bundle/preset-base-types.d.ts; rg -n "configure|export" build/esm/i18n/i18n.d.ts | head; rg -n "export" build/esm/index.d.ts | head -30

rg -n "interface CommonEditor" -A30 build/esm/common/*.d.ts | head -40; rg -n "YfmStaticView" build/esm/view/index.d.ts build/esm/view/components/*/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null|head; find build/esm/view -name "YfmStaticView*.d.ts" | xargs cat; rg -n "horizontal|vertical" build/esm/bundle/*.css build/esm/bundle/**/*.css 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n "useThemeValue|debounce" build/docs/guides/how-to-add-preview.md README.md | head

sed -n 1,60p build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.css; rg -n "split|preview" README.md | head; ls ../../@diplodoc/transform/dist/js 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n "\"(main|types|exports)\"" ../../@diplodoc/transform/package.json; ls ../../@diplodoc/transform/dist/css | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; rg -n "validationState|errorMessage|label\?|note\?|id\?" $U/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -20; rg -n "export type TextBaseProps|variant" $U/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head; ls $U/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && rg -n "theme\?|view\?|type\?|size\?" components/Card/Card.d.ts | head; rg -n "theme\?|title\?|message\?|view\?" components/Alert/types.d.ts | head; rg -n "export" components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; rg -ln "export declare const configure|export declare function configure" . | head -3; rg -n "type\?|loading\?|view\?" components/Button/Button.d.ts | head

sed -n 1,18p components/Card/Card.d.ts; rg -n "AlertTheme =|AlertView =" components/Alert/types.d.ts; cat utils/configure.d.ts; rg -n "ButtonProps.*type|type\?:" components/Button/Button.d.ts; rg -n "configure|Lang" ../../../markdown-editor/build/esm/configure.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && for t in --g-color-line-generic: --g-color-line-generic-hover: --g-color-line-generic-active: --g-color-line-danger: --g-border-radius-m: --g-spacing-3: --g-color-text-danger: --g-color-base-background:; do printf "%s %s\n" $t $(rg -c -- "$t" styles/styles.css); done; rg -n "type\?|extends" build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -5; ls ../markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/config | head; rg -n "^export" ../markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/config/index.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rg -n "export declare const (sp|spacing)\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { useCallback, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';\nimport { Alert, Button, Flex, Text, TextInput } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';",
"import { useCallback, useId, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';\nimport { Alert, Button, Flex, Text, TextInput, sp } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';")
s=s.replace("  const descriptionRef = useRef<MarkdownFieldHandle>(null);\n","  const descriptionRef = useRef<MarkdownFieldHandle>(null);\n  const titleId = useId();\n",1)
s=s.replace("<Flex direction=\"column\" gap={6} style={{ maxWidth: 840, margin: '0 auto', padding: 24 }}>",
"<Flex direction=\"column\" gap={6} className={sp({ p: 6 })} style={{ maxWidth: 840, margin: '0 auto' }}>")
s=s.replace("""          <TextInput
            size="l"
            label="Заголовок"
""","""          <Flex direction="column" gap={1}>
            <Text as="label" htmlFor={titleId} variant="subheader-1">
              Заголовок
            </Text>
            <TextInput
              id={titleId}
              size="l"
""")
s=s.replace("""            placeholder="Коротко о главном"
            value={title}
            onUpdate={setTitle}
            validationState={titleError ? 'invalid' : undefined}
            errorMessage={titleError}
          />""","""              placeholder="Коротко о главном"
              value={title}
              onUpdate={setTitle}
              validationState={titleError ? 'invalid' : undefined}
              errorMessage={titleError}
            />
          </Flex>""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/main.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';","import { ThemeProvider, configure as configureUikit } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\nimport { configure as configureMarkdownEditor } from '@gravity-ui/markdown-editor';")
s=s.replace("import { App } from './App';\n","import { App } from './App';\n\n// Interface language for uikit and the markdown editor toolbar.\nconfigureUikit({ lang: 'ru' });\nconfigureMarkdownEditor({ lang: 'ru' });\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
sed -i 's|"@gravity-ui/components": "^4.23.1"|"@gravity-ui/components": "4.23.1"|' package.json
npm install --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -2; npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | head -30
grep components package.json && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
rm -rf dist && git status --short
